chronologyPolicy.rule: A source snapshot and every dated observation must be strictly earlier than the assigned fixture kickoff.
chronologyPolicy.aggregateEligibility: Aggregate samples are eligible only because the complete raw profile snapshot predates kickoff; post-kickoff aggregate subtraction is forbidden.

missingDataPolicy.yellowVersusTotal: yellowCards is ordinary provider yellow count; totalCards is yellowCards + redCards and must remain a separate metric.
missingDataPolicy.zeroVersusMissing: Zero is an observed value; unavailable values remain null with a reason.

totalCards.proposedFamily: Hierarchical negative-binomial count model fitted on match-level chronological data.
totalCards.formula: Y_m ~ NegBin(mu_m, phi); log(mu_m) = alpha_competition_season + u_referee + beta^T x_match
totalCards.pooling: Estimate referee random effects with partial pooling. UCL and domestic competition effects remain distinct.
totalCards.recentForm: Use recent10 only as a learned covariate or replace aggregates with time-decayed match rows. Never add it as an independent sample because it overlaps career.
totalCards.overProbabilities: After fitting, derive P(Y_m >= 4), P(Y_m >= 5), P(Y_m >= 6) from the predictive distribution; do not average empirical Over rates.
totalCards.coefficients: All coefficients, dispersion, shrinkage and thresholds must be learned by pre-kickoff walk-forward calibration; none are set in Phase 2A.

individualCards.target: Ordinary player yellow card, kept separate from second-yellow and straight-red events.
individualCards.proposedFamily: Two-stage participation/exposure model plus hierarchical Bernoulli or discrete-time hazard model.
individualCards.formula: logit(p_player_match) = alpha + u_referee + u_player + beta^T(player fouls/cards, expected minutes, role, team/opponent context)
individualCards.lineupHandling: Condition on a timestamp-certified starter state, or model participation separately. Probable lineups without an acquisition time cannot enter calibration.
individualCards.coefficients: No coefficient, probability, risk score conversion or cutoff is supplied before calibration.

reliabilityIndicator.rule: CALIBRATED is impossible until the later calibration protocol passes; no arbitrary weights combine dimensions.

blockers: No match-level historical Champions training table currently joins referee assignment, pre-match team/player features and post-match card targets.
Career and recent10 aggregates overlap and cannot identify independent weights or time decay.
MD2 probable formations have date-only retrieval metadata, not a timestamp proving availability before each kickoff.
No Champions individual-card calibration set currently freezes ordinary-yellow labels, minutes/participation and information available at prediction time.
Eighteen future MD2 fixtures are a deployment cohort, not a calibration sample.
nextRequirements: Acquire match-level referee histories with stable match IDs, competition, kickoff, yellows, reds, fouls and penalties.
Join historical UEFA assignments to results without collapsing competitions or seasons.
Freeze timestamped pre-kickoff team and player feature snapshots plus certified lineup state.
Define ordinary-yellow and total-card targets explicitly and retain red-card outcomes separately.
Run rolling-origin calibration and evaluate count MAE/log score plus Brier/calibration for Over 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5.
Select weights, shrinkage and reliability thresholds only from out-of-sample results.
